title: The unopened letter, iii
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Wednesday. Gully sees it. Gully knows the logo — everyone knows the logo. Gully doesn't say the name. The strip's rule: the thing offering to animate him is never named.

panels.composition: The garage door open. GULLY in it with a coffee. The envelope on the table, visible from the door. Gully's eyes on it.

characters.pose: in the door, eyes on the envelope

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a stocky man standing in an open garage doorway with a coffee, his eyes on an envelope lying on a drafting table across the room

panels.composition: Gully's face. Recognition. The mouth opening to say the name.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, close-up of a stocky man's face in recognition with his mouth opening to speak, no words

panels.composition: Wood, not looking up from the pad, one finger raised.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a man at a drafting table raising one finger without looking up as a stocky man in the doorway stops mid-word

panels.composition: Gully sitting on the step with the coffee. The envelope on the table. The pup between them on the floor. The name unsaid, drawn as the blank shape, twice: on the envelope, and in Gully's empty balloon.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a stocky man sitting on a garage step with a coffee and an empty speech balloon above him, an envelope with a blank logo on a table, a small dog on the floor between
image.notes: Gully's balloon: drawn, empty. The name never lettered.

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet; 2019: the Sunday drawn to a smaller grid
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust; 2020: ochre and slate arriving

notes: 'Don't.' The name never said. An empty balloon.
